brief:
Comrades recalled the life of Dr. Khaled Abu Nada, deputy minister of education in Gaza, following his death, Shehab Wire reported. Abu Nada's colleagues traced his career in education and resistance work, describing a leader who left an enduring mark on teaching and prisoner advocacy.

The slain official's associates recounted his educational initiatives and his long engagement with Palestinian causes, honoring what they characterized as his sustained contributions to Gaza's schools and his work on behalf of imprisoned Palestinians.

title: Gaza education official Khaled Abu Nada killed in Israeli strike
